items.t: Applied Digital Sinks 8% as Nebius Outlook and NVIDIA CEO Exit Hit AI Data Center Stocks; Cipher Digital Falls 4%, TeraWulf Slides 3%
items.sum: A weak spending outlook from one AI cloud player and a surprise leadership change at the chip giant have rattled data center landlords. One name carrying heavy debt is feeling the pain most, and its next financing test may decide what comes next.

items.t: Cipher Digital Eyes 5.9 GW Pipeline: Can It Unlock Growth?
items.sum: CIFR expands its 5.9 GW HPC pipeline with hyperscaler agreements and on-site power capabilities to capitalize on rising AI infrastructure demand.

items.t: Applied Digital Rallies 8% as CoreWeave’s Results Revive the AI Data Center Trade; Cipher Digital Jumps 10%, IREN Surges 9%
items.sum: After a brutal month, AI data center stocks are snapping back on a single piece of financing news from CoreWeave. But Applied Digital's debt load and a hawkish Fed could still decide whether this bounce holds.

items.t: Why Is Cipher Digital Stock Surging on Wednesday?
items.sum: Cipher Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: CIFR) stock rose Wednesday following strong third-quarter earnings, capacity demand, and backlog updates from CoreWeave Inc. (NASDAQ: CRWV).

items.t: Could Cipher Digital Actually Climb 53%? Or Is Jefferies Totally Wrong?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysJefferies kept its Buy rating on Cipher Digital and cut its price target to $10 from $12. That’s still 53% above the Nov.

items.t: “That Stops When I’m Governor”: Cipher Digital and CleanSpark Sink Nearly 20% in a Week
items.sum: Key TakeawaysCipher Digital fell 20% in the week to Nov. 10, alongside CleanSpark and IREN, after Texas elected a governor who wants to pause new data centers.
